messages:
jordan_support: Customer 'Acme Corp' hitting 400 on tool call when passing a YAML blob inside the tool args string. Happening in prod, reproducible. Error: \"tool.arguments: invalid JSON\". Posting request+response below.

maria_support: Can you paste the raw curl and response body (no redaction)? Also which client SDK/version?

jordan_support: Curl (customer provided):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool": "yaml-processor", "args": "service:\n\tname: web\n\tport: 8080\n\tlabels:\n\t  env: production\n\t  owner: ops-team\n\t"}'
```

Response body: `{"error":{"message":"Invalid JSON in \"arguments\": unexpected literal at position 12","code":400}}`

maria_support: Ok. Looks like the client literally sent newlines and tabs inside the JSON string (unescaped). Our API expects the `arguments` field to be valid JSON string value (i.e. newlines must be escaped as `\\n` etc.). Which SDK did they use? Some older HTTP clients will auto-convert multi-line string bodies in shell paste and break escapes.

liam_runtime: That payload will break the JSON lexer. The error msg is from the schema validator downstream. Two quick options: 1) ask customer to JSON-escape the YAML block (replace real newlines with `\\n` and tabs with `\\t`) or 2) send the YAML as a separate multipart/form-data attachment and pass a reference in `args`.

jordan_support: Customer says they paste YAML into a web editor which POSTs via fetch; they expect to send raw text. They want the API to accept raw multiline strings. Any safe server-side parsing we can do?

liam_runtime: We could accept raw unescaped text for `arguments` and attempt to recover by reading the JSON up to the first closing brace then heuristically reparsing, but that's risky — ambiguous and could open parsing/SEC issues. Safer to fail with clearer validation messaging.

anya_sre: Agreed. Root cause is client producing invalid JSON; but our error is opaque. Recommend: improve validation error to call out unescaped control chars and provide a helpful snippet showing how to escape (examples for curl and JS fetch). I can own a small KB entry and a follow-up change to the error template.

maria_support: Jordan, can you ask Acme to try this quick repro/workaround? In JS fetch: 
```js
fetch('/v1/toolcall', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ...'},
  body: JSON.stringify({tool: 'yaml-processor', args: yamlText}) // JSON.stringify will escape newlines
})
```
Or in curl: use `--data-binary` with an already-escaped JSON string or pass the YAML base64-encoded: `\"args\": \"<base64 here>\"` and decode server-side.

jordan_support: Sent workaround. Customer tried JSON.stringify variant and it worked — API accepted the request and tool executed. They said UX expectation mismatch: their internal tooling pasted raw YAML expecting server to accept it.

liam_runtime: For short-term, let's add a clear error message in the schema validator: if unescaped control chars found -> respond 400 with message: \"invalid JSON in 'arguments': unescaped control characters (newlines/tabs). Use JSON.stringify or send as base64/multipart. Example: ...\". I'll open a tiny PR to change the error text.

anya_sre: I'll draft the KB doc and include examples for curl, fetch, and Python requests. Also add a note in the SDK docs.

maria_support: Jordan — tell Acme we'll update error text and doc this week. Offer them the base64/multipart workaround if they'd prefer not to change client code.

jordan_support: Customer happy with workaround. Will mark support case resolved once PR + KB published.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: change-set #1347 (runtime: improved JSON schema validation message). ETA 15m. :rocket:

liam_runtime: PR merged, monitoring for related errors. I also added a tiny snippet in the validator to catch unescaped newlines early and return the improved message.

anya_sre: KB: https://redwood.internal/kb/escaping-multiline-tool-args (draft). Linking in support case.

maria_support: Great. Closing thread after KB + deploy confirmed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
